description: Golden set for the data-table extraction eval. Values hand-verified against the PDFs in seed_data/. 'primitive' columns are stated verbatim in the paper; 'computed' columns require arithmetic and are never stated as a number in the paper — the compute agent produces them from a natural-language spec. Columns with expect_na are gap cases: the paper does not report the value, so a numeric answer is a fabrication/imputation failure.
